summary: WhatsApp gaps from Workshop ewatrade/assistant/conversations: family 16b scenes x-link-product, x-link-edited and x-link-expired, and family 8 scene rd-rep. (1) The review link message now names the draft with one bounded line from the canonical review presentation of that exact proposal revision (for example "Stock draft: +20 bags Long-grain Rice · 50kg"), never model text. After a saved edit on the review page the replacement link says "🔗 Same draft, new link for <Business · Store>.", lists up to three changed fields as "Label: ~old~ *new*" (plus "+N more changes on the page") when both revisions' review facts are readable, and ends with "The earlier link no longer works." A New link reply's link uses the same header without change lines. Scope, link, "Expires in 15 minutes. Nothing is saved until you approve it." stay on every message; an unreadable review falls back to the previous three lines. Dispatch reads the detail lines back, re-renders and refuses any other shape, and still re-reads the exact pending proposal revision and payload digest. (2) The link message carries fixed reply buttons: Cancel draft, plus New link on a replacement link. Taps are accepted only from that exact sent link outbox row on this binding with current authority, and act only on the revision that message showed; otherwise the fixed "That link or draft just changed" reply. Cancel uses the canonical proposal decision; New link reuses the existing recovery plan. (3) A WhatsApp request for a planned report (profit and loss, money collected, customer balances, stock) gets the openReportInApp navigation tool: a saved answer with the fixed "Reports and exports aren't in WhatsApp yet" instruction, the report's existing dashboard page (/finance/reports, /customer-ledger, /inventory) and the saved chat link, offered only to roles the report capability allows. Local only; no provider, OTP, schema or deployment change.
